g.text: The roles defined in RootFile are evaluated
only when settings.path points to the root file itself.
Otherwise, external PolicyFile(s) at path are loaded.
files: map of path to R, W, X [0..1]
User, Group: a name or a numeric id
GroupSet: one group, or a list of groups
del is an alias of sub
Task -> Role -> PolicyFile / RootFile -> Built-in defaults
set: map of name to value
